card.name: Joining words in combination drug names
card.fires_on: The word 'and' or a comma right after the first drug in a combination product name, such as Lisinopril and Hydrochlorothiazide or Olmesartan, amlodipine, and hydro-. The next word is expected to be the second drug.

modes.label: And between drug names
modes.description: 'and' linking the first and second drug in a combination tablet name.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Trandolapril<< and>> verapamil hydrochloride extended-release

modes.label: Comma in drug lists
modes.description: A comma after the first drug in a three-drug combination name.
modes.example: omagnesmia can result in hypokalemia which may be difficult to treat despite potassium repletion. Olmesartan medoxomil<<,>> amlodipine, and hydro

modes.label: Dose schedule joins
modes.description: A joining piece inside dosing-frequency phrases such as once-a-day or every 24 hours.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese characters and look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires at the small joining word between the two drugs in a combination product name.
